sql:
SELECT t.name as merchant_name,
  concat('2025-Q', extract(quarter from tk.created_at)::int) as quarter,
  count(*) as tickets_created,
  count(distinct tk.assignee_agent_id) as distinct_agents,
  round(count(*)::numeric / nullif(count(distinct tk.assignee_agent_id),0), 1) as tickets_per_agent
FROM tickets tk
JOIN tenants t on t.id = tk.tenant_id
WHERE t.name in ('Cragsley Outfitters','Marrowby & Vane','Studio Vrij','Grind Collective')
  AND tk.created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' and tk.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY t.name, extract(quarter from tk.created_at)
ORDER BY t.name, extract(quarter from tk.created_at)
note: Grain is tenant x calendar quarter for 2025, limited to the four named tenants; tickets_per_agent is tickets_created / distinct assignee_agent_id (NULL when a tenant/quarter has zero assigned agents).
